title: T035 exact-candidate X-COM verification matrix and repository-owned results

scope.intended_use: Execute and retain the complete exact-candidate capability-007 verification matrix: the full C++ unit/contract/integration/negative/concurrency/sanitizer checks, the static-analysis measure, the inherited Phase 6 conformance recheck, and all existing Python tests, with command argv, exit status, deterministic outcomes, tool/environment identity, bounded logs, and artifact hashes bound to the exact candidate revision, without changing any accepted production source or test and without claiming benchmark, Doxygen, traceability-verifier, external-review, or acceptance results owned by T036-T041.
boundaries: Bounded capability-007 Phase 8 verification scope: the T035 work products, the T035 engineering requirement/component/unit/validation records, the exact-candidate verification report reports/xcom-queue/t035-verification.json, the T035 trace links, and the Phase 8 verification-measure descriptors.

No change to any accepted production source, header, contract, schema, register, XDL profile, T030 contract, T031/T032 gateway/client, or T033/T034 suite; no new dependency; no TCP listener, AF_INET/AF_INET6 socket, DNS, resolver, TLS, external peer, legacy binary, production workload, or linked gRPC runtime.

T035 changes are limited to docs/engineering/xcom/t035/**, the new engineering/requirements|architecture/components|unit-specifications|validation/scenarios T035 records, engineering/verification/measures/**, engineering/trace/links.json, engineering/project.json, reports/review-index.md, reports/xcom-queue/t035-verification.json, and the one-line T035 checkbox in specs/007-xcom-core/tasks.md (implementation stage only).
success_criteria: Every accepted T035 software requirement is traced to the applicable X-Verse system anchor, component, unit, code, verification measure, and named executed case or inspection.

The full C++ suite, sanitizer build, static analysis, inherited Phase 6 conformance recheck, whole-system integration measure, and all existing Python tests execute and pass at the exact candidate revision, with no existing target, label, count, or expected value reduced.

reports/xcom-queue/t035-verification.json records commands, outcomes, hashes, environment, bounded logs, and exact-candidate identity; a missing, stale, mismatched, skipped, or failed measure is reported as failed or blocked, never as pass.
Independent review and strict delivery validation bind the exact candidate before acceptance.

reliability.basis: Deterministic offline full-matrix runs over the accepted capability-007 platform in the admitted X-COM build envelope, with each measure's outcome derived from its trusted discovery check and bound to the exact candidate revision.

authority.decision_rule: Any conflict with the accepted capability-007 specification, constitution, accepted ADRs, T007 ownership register, T008 requirement register, T009 architecture model, the accepted T010 unit design, or an accepted predecessor candidate is resolved in favour of the accepted source; material gaps are recorded, not guessed. T035 records evidence only: it changes no accepted production source, header, contract, schema, register, or test, and no accepted predecessor work product.

verification_profile_note: Trusted policy requires explicit unit, static-analysis, whole-system integration, validation, conformance, and sanitizer measures for the T035 exact-candidate verification matrix; T035 neither defines nor replaces them.
